testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a taper change to an existing feature ✔> Given a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd" is open in the part modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given the user edits the fixture extrusion, sets Taper A to 5 degrees and accepts the edit ✔ And the user reopens the extrusion for editing ✔ When the user reverses the taper sign ✔ Then Taper A is -5 degrees and the preview narrows ✔ When the user cancels the edit and reopens the extrusion for editing ✔ Then Taper A remains 5 degrees
